data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.

**Target:** A **DEATHWING** unit of yours that is a target of any of that enemy unit's attacks.

**Effect:** Whenever a model of the unit that has not yet fought in the phase is **destroyed**, roll a D6, with +1 to the roll if the unit is in range of the Vowed [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) of your army. On a 4+, the model stays in play: once the attacking unit is done attacking, it can fight, and it is removed after that. This lasts for the rest of the phase.
